TextItem.Description: Located in the heart of Fujairah, connected to Al Taif Mall. We feature a Lounge, Restaurant & the largest ballroom in town along with meeting venues.

This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids menu. The hotel offers kid's amenities.Our upscale hotel boasts 228 well-appointed guest rooms. Culinary aficionados can indulge at our dining spots and stylish bar, StrEAT Culture, Dura Caf?, and Bistro 1550 for an unparalleled dining experience. Linked seamlessly to the Al Taif Business Centre and Mall, our hotel stands just one kilometer from the majestic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Central Fujairah and Fujairah International Airport FJR are a mere two kilometers from our door. Within a short, ten-minute drive, you'll discover an array of attractions, from the bustling City Center Mall to the trendy Umbrella Beach, as well as the thrilling Fujairah Adventure Park. Our inviting outdoor pool offers an ideal place to unwind and soak up the sun while the little ones have a blast in their dedicated kids' pool. We also offer an onsite beauty salon, located on our third floor, as well as a spa. For those seeking elegance in event hosting, our five versatile meeting rooms and an opulent ballroom, accommodating up to 1000 guests, set the stage for unforgettable gatherings. Whether it's a corporate event or a grand celebration, our expansive event spaces cater to every need.

DoubleTree by Hilton Fujairah City is located at the heart of Fujairah City Centre, the hotel forms part of a mixed-use development known as Al Taif Business Centre which includes offices and residences.
